subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words. **

Animals and plants which live in water
solution:
The correct answer is '**Aquatic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Aquatic**'.
 
• It means** ****'any animal, whether invertebrate or vertebrate, that lives in water for most or all of its lifetime'. **(कोई भी जानवर, चाहे वह अकशेरुकी हो या कशेरुकी, जो अपने पूरे जीवन काल में पानी में रहता है)
 
 
• *Example: Many forms of **aquatic** life inhabit ponds.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Aquatic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Terrestrial**: animals that live predominantly or entirely on land. (भौमिक, स्‍थलीय; जानवर जो मुख्य रूप से या पूरी तरह से जमीन पर रहते हैं)
 
• **Amphibian**: an animal that can live both on land and in water. (जल और थल दोनों में रह सकने वाला प्राणी; जलस्‍थलचर)
 
• **Aerial**: animals who can fly, soar or glide easily in the air. (ऐसे जानवर जो हवा में आसानी से उड़ सकते हैं)
